'''Mubasa sauce''' was a spicy sauce which could be consumed by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="RF:R" /> It partially shared its name with [[Mubasa hock]], another type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="GPBATG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] ate a live<ref name="RF:R" /> [[Gorg/Legends|gorg]], an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] creature<ref name="DB">{{DB|creature|gorg|gorg}}</ref> which had been coated in mubasa sauce, while he questioned a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] in the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Hutt's palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="RF:R" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mubasa sauce first appeared in ''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]'', a novel released in [[2009]] and written by [[Alex Wheeler]].<ref name="RF:R" />
